title: lint: an app-package permission set's field key on a field a sibling package adds through objectExtensions is refused as security-fls-unknown-field, though the runtime serves the merged field
body:
## Source

Measured by HotCRM on platform **18.3.0** during hotcrm#2315 phase 0 (Order to Cash as a `type: 'module'` package of the HotCRM artifact, PR hotcrm#2413). The implementer's report is [hotcrm#2315 comment 6650597139](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/issues/2315#issuecomment-6650597139). Evidence is in the HotCRM project files under `issue-2315/` (`probe-module.patch`). The maintainer's ruling of 2026-11-05 on hotcrm#2315 says the module's extension fields get their access in the **app package's** permission sets: reps read, finance edits.

## What happens

The HotCRM artifact carries five packages. `app.objectstack.hotcrm` (`type: app`) owns `crm_contract` and the permission sets. The `app.objectstack.hotcrm.o2c` module adds a field to `crm_contract` through `objectExtensions`, here the probe `o2c_probe_note`.

- An app-package permission set that names `crm_contract.o2c_probe_note` in its `fields` is refused. `pnpm build` and `objectstack dev` both exit 1 with rule `security-fls-unknown-field`: "crm_contract declares no field o2c_probe_note".
- The runtime serves the merged field. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_contract` lists it, and `GET /api/v1/data/crm_contract/<id>` returns its value.
- So the field exists on the served object, but no permission set in the artifact may name it.

## Where (objectstack `main` `bff5ba21`, unchanged at `a26abbc6`)

- `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`: the object index that the FLS-key check reads (`indexObjectGraph`) is built from `stack.objects` or each package's objects only. It folds no `objectExtensions` entry, whether from the same body or from a sibling body.
- The controlled-by-parent checks in the same file already judge the merged field set across `packages[]` bodies (`extensionMergedCbpFindings`, #23210). The FLS check does not.

## Ask

When the FLS-key check runs on a multi-package artifact, it should resolve `object.field` against the object as the registry will serve it, with the `objectExtensions` of every body in the artifact folded in. This is the same fold the controlled-by-parent checks use. A key on a field that no body declares or extends stays refused.

## Consumer

hotcrm#2315 phase 1 (the O2C module's contract and account fields) is Blocked-by this card. ⛔ HotCRM does not work around it.
